select T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T1.CCY ccy, T2.EXC_DEAL_TYPE excDealType, T1.PS ps, T1.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, T1.PRICE price, T2.VDATE vdate, T2.MDATE mdate, T1.PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH proAvailableCash, T2.CUR_PAIR curPair, T2.SETTLE_SPREED settleSpreed, T2.COR_CCY corCcy, T2.COR_CUR_POS corCurPos, T2.EXP_COR_AMT expCorAmt, T2.DEAL_CUR_ACCT dealCurAcct, T2.COR_CUR_ACCT corCurAcct, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T3.TRADER trader, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T1.REMARK remark from ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T3 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T3.ENTRUST_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
